entry.name: %FACTORY_DOCKER_HOST%
entry.comment: URI of the Docker daemon the workspaces run in.

entry.name: %FACTORY_DOCKER_NETWORK%
entry.comment: Docker network the workspace containers join.

entry.name: %FACTORY_PUBLIC_HOST%
entry.comment: Host name under which a browser reaches the published workspace ports.

entry.name: %FACTORY_HOST_PORT_MIN%
entry.comment: Lowest host port a workspace port is published on.

entry.name: %FACTORY_HOST_PORT_MAX%
entry.comment: Highest host port a workspace port is published on.

entry.name: %FACTORY_HOST_IP%
entry.comment: Address of the daemon host the workspace ports are published on; empty for all addresses.

entry.name: %FACTORY_DOCKER_ISOLATE%
entry.comment: Whether the workspace containers are kept from reaching each other on the workspace network (set when the network is created).

entry.name: %FACTORY_WORKSPACE_MEMORY%
entry.comment: Memory a workspace container may use, e.g. 8g; 0 for no limit.

entry.name: %FACTORY_WORKSPACE_CPUS%
entry.comment: CPUs a workspace container may use, e.g. 4 or 1.5; 0 for no limit.

entry.name: %FACTORY_WORKSPACE_PIDS%
entry.comment: Processes and threads a workspace container may run at once; 0 for no limit.

entry.name: %FACTORY_ENGINE_VERSION%
entry.comment: TopLogic version a new application is built on.

entry.name: %FACTORY_IMAGE_REPOSITORY%
entry.comment: Name (without tag) of the image the application workspaces run.

entry.name: %FACTORY_REPOSITORY_URL%
entry.comment: Maven repository the TopLogic releases are taken from.

entry.name: %FACTORY_START_TIMEOUT%
entry.comment: Seconds to wait for a started application to answer.

entry.name: %FACTORY_BUILD_TIMEOUT%
entry.comment: Seconds a Maven run in a workspace may take.

entry.name: %FACTORY_CONTEXT_PATH%
entry.comment: Context path the application of a workspace is served under; {context} stands for the context path of the control application, {workspace} for the identifier of the workspace, {artifact} for the artifact of the application.

entry.name: %FACTORY_APPLICATION_ORIGIN%
entry.comment: Origin (e.g. https://factory.example.com) under which a browser reaches the applications of the workspaces, given to them as tl_host; empty if not known. It must answer /admin/stop with another status than 200.

entry.name: %FACTORY_DOCKER_EXTRA_HOSTS%
entry.comment: Comma separated host:address entries added to the host names a workspace container resolves, e.g. host.docker.internal:host-gateway.

entry.name: %FACTORY_PROXY_URL%
entry.comment: URL of the root of the workspace proxy as the workspace containers reach it, without the path of a route, e.g. http://host.docker.internal:8091; empty switches the proxy off.

entry.name: %FACTORY_PROXY_ADDRESS%
entry.comment: Address the workspace proxy listens on with a port of its own.

entry.name: %FACTORY_PROXY_PORT%
entry.comment: Port the workspace proxy listens on, apart from the port of the control application; 0 for none.

entry.name: %FACTORY_PROXY_SERVLET%
entry.comment: Whether the workspace proxy also answers in the web application, at the paths of its servlet, e.g. /llm-proxy.

entry.name: %FACTORY_PROXY_RATE_LIMIT%
entry.comment: Requests per minute a workspace proxy token may make; 0 for no limit.

entry.name: %FACTORY_GIT_PROTECTED_FILES%
entry.comment: Comma separated glob patterns of the files of a project repository no push to its default branch may change; such a change needs a reviewed pull request. The pipeline file of the CI server is protected in addition once the CI of the project is set up.

entry.name: %FACTORY_GIT_USER_NAME%
entry.comment: Author and committer name of the commits made in the workspaces, by the agent and the control application; empty for none.

entry.name: %FACTORY_GIT_USER_EMAIL%
entry.comment: Author and committer e-mail address of the commits made in the workspaces; empty for none.

entry.name: %FACTORY_LLM_PROVIDER%
entry.comment: Name of the Anthropic provider of the LLMProviderService whose API key the LLM route of the workspace proxy adds to the requests of the workspaces.

entry.name: %FACTORY_PROXY_ALLOWED_SOURCES%
entry.comment: Comma separated client addresses the workspace proxy accepts requests from: CIDR ranges (IPv4 or IPv6) or workspace-network for the network of the workspace containers; empty accepts every address.

entry.name: %FACTORY_AGENT_MODEL%
entry.comment: Model the coding agent of the workspaces works with, e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6; empty for the default of Claude Code.

entry.name: %FACTORY_AGENT_THINKING_DISPLAY%
entry.comment: How the thinking of the coding agent appears in its output: summarized for a summary the chat shows, omitted for none, empty for the default of Claude Code.

entry.name: %FACTORY_AGENT_EXTRA_ARGS%
entry.comment: Comma separated further arguments of the command line of the coding agent, e.g. --max-turns,50.

entry.name: %FACTORY_AGENT_IDLE_TIMEOUT%
entry.comment: How long the process of an agent conversation is kept after its last answer.

entry.name: %FACTORY_AGENT_TOKEN_LIFETIME%
entry.comment: Lifetime of the workspace proxy token of an agent process; at most the longest token lifetime of the proxy.

entry.name: %FACTORY_LOG_FLUSH_INTERVAL%
entry.comment: Milliseconds between two commits of the output of a running workspace operation.

entry.name: %FACTORY_MAX_LOG_SIZE%
entry.comment: Number of characters of the output of a workspace operation that are stored.
